#+TITLE: The drawer-at-column-zero trap
#+TODO: TODO NEXT | DONE CANCELLED

# go-org ends a headline's body at a drawer written in column zero, which leaves
# Headline.Properties nil and hoists the rest of the heading to the top level of
# the document. Both habits below are written the way plenty of real org files
# are written, and neither of them is a habit as far as the parser is concerned:
# IsHabit() is false because :STYLE: never reaches Properties, and the LOGBOOK
# is not among the headline's children to be read.
#
# Keep this file if you want the trap covered; delete it if an unstyled habit in
# the corpus is just noise.

SCHEDULED: <2026-09-26 Sat .+1m/45d>
:PROPERTIES:
:STYLE:    habit
:END:
:LOGBOOK:
- State "DONE"       from "TODO"       [2026-08-26 Wed 19:00]
:END:
